meta.question: When was the Prophet ﷺ born?

data.answer: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was born on a Monday, the 12th of Rabi' al-Awwal, which corresponds to April 20, 571 CE. His birth took place at dawn in his mother's house in Makkah al-Mukarramah, approximately 55 days after the Incident of As-hab-al-Feel.
